inspection_basis: Actual view_image tool inspections followed by decoded RGBA identity comparison for post-build delivery rerenders. Record time is separate from pixel-view clock observation.
observations: The final eight views show a continuous tapered helicoid with two rounded node rows per whorl; closed axial infill removes the prior top hole. The low mouth has a bounded cavity. Its broad lower terminal whorl and regular repeated node rhythm remain more schematic than the concept; the side view retains a pointed lower lip profile. These are declared maker limitations for independent review, not an acceptance verdict.
